bio: Appel Thaï, which is a firm favourite with fans of Asian fare, makes the most of its lush green oasis in Anderlecht. Choose between the peaceful terrace or the buzzier, casual vibe indoors. Fresh, spicy, intense flavours crafted by a veteran chef. Home-made nems served with a tingling sauce, rich massaman curry or a Pad Thai all cooked to textbook perfection: high-flying Thai cuisine in an unstuffy, relaxed setting. Wide variety of choice and dependable first-rate quality....
